question: What was Lotus Technology revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2024, and how did it compare with the same period in 2023?
answer: For the nine months ended September 30, 2024, Lotus Technology reported revenue of $652.8 million, compared to $317.9 million for the same period in 2023. This represents a year-over-year increase of approximately 105%, driven by growing vehicle deliveries and expansion in both sales of goods and service revenues.

Sales of goods reached $624 million, reflecting a 104% year-on-year increase. Service revenues also surged by 129% year-on-year, totaling $29 million and making up 4.4% of total revenue, an increase from 3.9% in the same period of 2023. Proactive inventory management strategies resulted in a temporary impact on gross margin, but this was partially offset by the growth of the high-margin intelligent driving business. The cost of revenues rose to $593,708,000 from $284,193,000, resulting in a gross profit of $59,115,000 compared to $33,748,000 in the previous year. Total operating expenses for the period amounted to $656,860,000, a rise from $541,624,000 in 2023. This included research and development expenses of $227,525,000 and selling and marketing expenses of $259,804,000. General and administrative expenses were $175,342,000. In the nine months ending September 30, 2024, Lotus reported a net loss of $666,520,000, an increase from the $526,524,000 reported in the same period in 2023. The adjusted net loss, which accounts for share-based compensation expenses, was $632,955,000 for 2024 compared to $526,524,000 in 2023. For the same period, interest expenses rose to $20,557,000 from $7,367,000, while interest income decreased slightly from $7,258,000 in 2023 to $15,276,000. Income tax expenses were $1,155,000, down from $1,350,000.
